name: Amazon Seller Central
shortInfo: Amazon Seller Central helps merchants and sellers to market and sell their products directly to customers within the Amazon marketplace.
brief: Amazon Seller Central helps merchants and sellers to market and sell their products directly to customers within the Amazon marketplace. An Amazon Seller Central account is considered a marketplace or third-party Amazon seller (3P) where seller is responsible for setting up and maintaining their seller account. Build, grow, and scale your brand with Amazon's innovative toolkit: world-class logistics, a proven customer experience, rich data insights, and cutting-edge advertising & marketing solutions.
about:
Start selling on India's most visited shopping destination. Trusted by 10 Lakh+ businesses. Avail free listing support ,No Product Listing Fees. Millions of Customers. World Class Services. Flexibility.  
  
Learn more about [Amazon Seller Central API documentation.](https://sellercentral.amazon.in/)
availableData:
[FBA Amazon Fulfilled Inventory Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/amazon-seller-central/pipelines/fba-amazon-fulfilled-inventory-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve tab-delimited flat file report where content is updated in near real-time.

[FBA Daily Inventory History Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/amazon-seller-central/pipelines/fba-daily-inventory-history-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve tab-delimited flat file report that contains historical daily snapshots of a seller’s available inventory in Amazon’s fulfillment centers including quantity, location, and disposition.

[FBA Inbound Performance Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/amazon-seller-central/pipelines/fba-inbound-performance-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve tab-delimited flat file report that contains inbound shipment problems by product and shipment.

[FBA Inventory Adjustments Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/amazon-seller-central/pipelines/fba-inventory-adjustments-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve tab-delimited flat file report that contains corrections and updates to a seller’s inventory in response to issues such as damage, loss, receiving discrepancies, etc.

[FBA Inventory Age Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/amazon-seller-central/pipelines/fba-inventory-age-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve tab-delimited flat file report that indicates the age of inventory, which helps sellers take action to avoid paying the Long Term Storage Fee.

[FBA Inventory Event Detail Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/amazon-seller-central/pipelines/fba-inventory-event-detail-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve tab-delimited flat file report that contains history of inventory events (for example, receipts, shipments, adjustments etc.) by SKU and fulfillment center.

Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/amazon-seller-central/index.html) here.
